name: IRC_BULK_ACTIONS
description: Stores Bulk action data for processing.

columns.name: BULK_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: CONTEXT_TYPE
columns.description: Business Object Type - It can be SUBMISSION_LIST or PROSPECT_LIST or POOL_MEMBER_LIST or CANDIDATE_SEARCH_LIST or RECOMMENDATION_LIST

columns.name: CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Stores the Id releated to the Context Type Ex: REQUISITION_ID , POOL_ID etc

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Stores what type of action need to be performed for Bulk actions like MOVE_CANDIDATE or SEND_EMAIL or DELETE_SUBMISSION

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the status of the Bulk Action. Lookup type - ORA_IRC_BULK_ACTION_STATUS

columns.name: SUBMITTED_BY_USER
columns.description: stores the username who created the row.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_DATE
columns.description: stores the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: QUERY
columns.description: Stores the query

columns.name: QUERY_PARAMS
columns.description: Stores query params list in hash map

columns.name: SELECTED_FILTERS
columns.description: Stores filtered label and values for display purpose (notification email and on action page)

columns.name: QUERY_SOURCE
columns.description: Stores what type of Query it need to be like FILTER_BASED (or) MANUAL_SELECTION

columns.name: UNSELECTED_IDS
columns.description: Stores Comma separated unselected Object Ids list

columns.name: ESS_JOB_ID
columns.description: Store ESS Job Id

columns.name: ACTION_DATA
columns.description: Stores HashMap object which contains action data like new phase/state, email template etc..

columns.name: CONSUMER_IMPL_CLASS
columns.description:
Stores Implementation class patch which need to be executed

Ex: "oracle.apps.hcm.recruiting.thirdParty.backgroundCheck.publicModelService.bulkActions.SubmissionBulkAction"

columns.name: CONSUMER_AM_DEF
columns.description:
Stores Consumer Application Module Definition in which action need to be performed

Ex: "oracle.apps.hcm.recruiting.hiring.submissions.core.protectedModel.applicationModule.SubmissionAM"

columns.name: CONSUMER_AM_CONFIG_DEF
columns.description:
Stores Consumer Application Module Configuration Definition in which action need to be performed

Ex: "SubmissionAMLocal"

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_TOKENS
columns.description: Stores notification tokens for which bulk action is processed

columns.name: TOTAL_COUNT
columns.description: Stores total number of rows for which bulk action is processed

columns.name: FAILED_COUNT
columns.description: Stores failed rows count for which bulk action is processed

columns.name: SKIPPED_COUNT
columns.description: Stores skipped rows count for which bulk action is processed

columns.name: CANCELLED_COUNT
columns.description: Stores cancelled rows count for which bulk action is processed

columns.name: FAILED_IDS
columns.description: Stores Comma separated failed row Ids

columns.name: SKIPPED_IDS
columns.description: Stores Comma separated skipped row Ids

columns.name: CANCELLED_IDS
columns.description: Comma separated cancelled row Ids

columns.name: DEBUG_QUERY_PARAMS
columns.description: Stores query params in CLOB format. This is used for debugging purpose

columns.name: DEBUG_ACTION_DATA
columns.description: Stores action data in CLOB format. This is used for debugging purpose

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
